definitions.explanation: Water that has fallen as rain and collected on the ground, in tanks, or other containers. Used in everyday contexts as well as in discussions of water management and gardening.

examples.japanese: {雨水|あまみず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦タンク→タンク：23095_tanku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貯|た}める→貯める：27801_tameru⟧。
⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雨水|あまみず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{水|みず}やり→水やり：06328_mizuyari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I use rainwater to water the flowers in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{流|なが}れ{落|お}ちる{雨水|あまみず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{排水溝|はいすいこう}→排水溝：07335_haisuikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まり→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冠水|かんすい}→冠水：20916_kansui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}いでいる→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: Rainwater flowing off the roof collects in the drain, preventing the road from flooding.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The kanji {雨水|あまみず} can also be read うすい, which refers to the traditional calendar term for the onset of spring rains (around February 19). The reading あまみず is the everyday word for rainwater.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨水|あまみず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯|た}める→貯める：27801_tameru⟧ (to collect/store rainwater)
- {雨水|あまみず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧ (to make use of rainwater)
- {雨水|あまみず}⟦タンク→タンク：23095_tanku⟧ (rainwater tank)
- {雨水|あまみず}⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧ (rainwater drainage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雨水|あまみず}: rainwater (collected or fallen rain)
- ⟦{湧|わ}き{水|みず}→湧き水：18173_wakimizu⟧: spring water (from underground)
- ⟦{水道水|すいどうすい}→水道水：25349_suidousui⟧: tap water (municipal supply)
